CRITICAL FAILURE: Plant wilted. Stomata are closed.
STARVATION: No CO2 available to make sugar.
SYSTEM FROZEN: Too cold. Enzymes inactive.
GOOD RATE: Photosynthesis is maxed but careful with the roots Only about 1 of the water absorbed by the roots is actually utilised in photosynthesis.
